programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: It's day one of the competition in east London. Fashionista Simran Samra hosts a glitz and glam night for her guests as she goes head to head with doctor Chintu Gademsetty, comedian Yoshki Greenberg, city boy Alan Price and businesswoman Delia Elliot. Simran cooks meat despite being a vegetarian and buys wine despite the fact she knows nothing about it, and her main course isn't a success.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: On day two in east London, laid-back comedian Yoshki Greenberg aims to throw a relaxing dinner party and give her guests a good laugh, but Yoshki has a surprise up her sleeve: on arrival she hands her guests animal-themed pyjama suits. Sadly not all the guests are put at ease by wearing somebody else's clothes, especially as they haven't even been washed.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: It's day three in east London and jack-the-lad Alan Price aims to wow his guests with a medieval themed feast. After two nights of disappointing food, Alan hopes he can raise the standard this week with an ambitious menu, but his dinner party doesn't get off to the best start when his medieval table decoration, a whole pig's head, sends vegetarian Simran in to a state of panic.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: On day four in east London it's the turn of bar owner Delia Elliot to host. Cordon Bleu cook Delia has purposefully played down her menu in an attempt to wow her guests. Despite this, expectations are high. As the elder of the group, Delia's confident she can teach her young diners a thing or two about how to throw a good dinner party. However not all the youngsters want to listen.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: On the final day in east London doctor Chintu Gademsetty is confident of winning with his 80s-themed dinner party, but first he needs to create a cheery atmosphere following the tensions of the past two nights, and secondly he needs to out-do Delia's Cordon Bleu cookery. The night begins well when Chintu delights with his MC Hammer costume and Knight Rider car, but who will be the ultimate winner?

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Kaun Kare Kurbanie
programme.desc: Honest and upright, Inspector Arjun is very different from his happy-go-lucky younger brother Ajit. Their relationship hits rocky ground after Ajit is accused of murder.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Market Raja MBBS
programme.desc: While in the pursuit of Raja, a ruthless don, the police accidentally kill Chandrababu, a medical student. Things take a turn when Chandrababu's spirit possesses Raja and turns him into a gentle soul.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha
programme.desc: Inspector Malik transfers to Mumbai along with his family and sets out on a mission to catch King, an underworld leader. However, a shocking revelation changes the course of their lives.

programme.title: Bollywood Bang Bang

programme.title: Craig Charles: UFO Conspiracies
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Phoenix LightsIn 1997, over the city of Phoenix, Arizona, one of the most spectacular mass UFO sighting of all time took place. Thousands of people witnessed a series of bright orange orbs moving in formation silently overhead. Despite hours of video and photographic evidence this case remains unexplained. Craig and space journalist Sarah Cruddas talk to eyewitness nurse David Parker who provides a vivid description of his close-up encounter with a huge boomerang-shaped UFO that passed directly overhead. They also investigate the response by the authorities in the days following the UFO event.

programme.desc: S10 E7 — Computer CrashWhen the computers go down, chaos at American Jewelry runs sky high. But when Seth discovers that the glitch has made it nearly impossible to track pawned items, their whole reputation could be on the line.

programme.title: Craig Charles: UFO Conspiracies
programme.desc: S1 E7 — ChicagoCraig and co-host Sarah Cruddas examine the Chicago O'Hare International Airport case of November 2006 - the sighting of a flying saucer hovering over a United Airlines airport gate. The incident was witnessed by multiple aviation professionals, pilots and passengers. The immediate aftermath of the event was captured in real time by audio recordings of communication between the airport's Air Traffic Control tower and airline staff, but the sighting was dismissed by the US government's Federal Aviation Administration as a weather phenomenon. Craig and Sarah talk to UFO investigator Robert Powell, who reveals the UFO punched a circular hole in the clouds as it departed upwards after hovering over the terminal. Craig and Sarah also learn astonishing details about how aviation authorities handled the incident.

programme.title: Ghost Ships

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A nameless stay-at-home Mother tends to her young son in the suburbs while Husband casually goes out to work. Trapped in a whirlpool of rage and frustration about the loss of her identity, Mother becomes convinced that she is turning into one of the dogs that roam the neighbourhood. Dark comedy adapted from Rachel Yoder's magical realist novel, starring Amy Adams and Scoot McNairy.

programme.title: The Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Overworked estate agent Jim Evers takes his beleaguered family to look round an isolated, crumbling mansion - but the resident ghosts are not especially pleased to see the visitors. Comedy based on the Disney theme-park ride, starring Eddie Murphy, Terence Stamp, Jennifer Tilly and Marsha Thomason.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: The Tigger Movie
programme.desc: Tigger realises being the only one of his kind makes for a lonely life, so he sets off on a bold quest to find more creatures just like him, with the help of his woodland friends. Animated adventure, with the voices of Jim Cummings, Nikita Hopkins, Ken Sansom, John Fiedler, Tom Attenborough and Peter Cullen.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
programme.desc: Join pals Pooh, Piglet, Kanga, Roo, Owl, Rabbit, Tigger and Christopher Robin as they enjoy their days together and sing their way through a collection of adventures. With the voices of Sterling Holloway, Paul Winchell, Sebastian Cabot and Junius Matthews.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: An old man attaches thousands of balloons to his house so he can fly it to South America, and fulfil his late wife's dream of exploring the jungle. However, once airborne, he finds he has an unwanted stowaway in the shape of an excitable boy scout. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Ed Asner, Jordan Nagai and Christopher Plummer.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Freaky Friday
programme.desc: A rebellious teenage girl is shocked to learn her mother is planning on getting married again, but soon sees things from her parent's perspective when they magically swap bodies. As the mortified mum rediscovers the highs and lows of adolescence and her daughter gets to grips with working life, they finally begin to understand each other. Comedy remake, with Jamie Lee Curtis and Lindsay Lohan.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: John Carter
programme.desc: An American Civil War soldier is transported to an alien planet, which is also being torn apart by conflict. He intercedes in this struggle after rescuing a princess from captivity, and must win the trust of a fierce primitive tribe to save the world. Fantasy adventure based on Edgar Rice Burroughs' series of novels, starring Taylor Kitsch and Lynn Collins.

programme.title: Iron Man
programme.desc: Arms manufacturer Tony Stark is taken hostage by a terrorist group and realises the weapons his company build have been falling into the wrong hands. Using his engineering skills to construct a hi-tech armoured suit, he manages to escape and then puts the technology to good use in the fight against evil around the world. Superhero adventure, starring Robert Downey Jr, Jeff Bridges, Gwyneth Paltrow and Terrence Howard.

programme.title: Hitchcock
programme.desc: Following his success with North by Northwest, director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel Psycho. After being refused backing by the studio Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. Even with His wifes support, Alma Reville, the production strains the couples marriage. Fact-based drama, starring Anthony Hopkins, Helen Mirren and Scarlett Johansson.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Pocahontas
programme.desc: A Native American princess falls in love with an English settler, but her father is distrustful of the Europeans - not without just cause, as a cruel governor is prepared to wage war to get his hands on the gold he believes they are hiding. Animated drama, with the voices of Irene Bedard, Mel Gibson and Christian Bale.

programme.title: Cars 2
programme.desc: Racing car Lightning McQueen heads overseas to compete in an international grand prix, with events in Britain, Japan and Italy. He gets mixed up in international espionage when a case of mistaken identity leads to an encounter with two English spy cars searching for a powerful gadget. Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: A wizard living secretly in modern-day New York vows to prevent his mystical enemy from taking over the city. Realising that he is unable to complete the task alone, he recruits an ordinary teenager to be his assistant, teaching him to master the magical arts. Fantasy adventure, starring Nicolas Cage, Jay Baruchel and Alfred Molina.

programme.title: Ratatouille
programme.desc: A rat finds his love of fine food has made him an outcast to his less discerning family. Separated from his fellow rodents by a storm, he winds up in a famous French restaurant, where he helps an incompetent kitchen assistant become the greatest chef in Paris. Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol 2
programme.desc: After saving Xandar from Ronan's wrath, intergalactic outlaws Peter Quill (AKA Star-Lord), Gamora, Drax the Destroyer, Groot and Rocket Raccoon are recognised as heroes. Now, they must fight to stay together as they unravel the mystery surrounding Ego, a man who claims to be Quill's father. Writer/director James Gunn's follow up to his 2014 blockbuster, which reunites Chris Pratt, Zoe Saldana, Karen Gillan and Dave Bautista, with support from Kurt Russell, Sylvester Stallone and Pom Klementieff. Bradley Cooper also provides the voice of Rocket and Vin Diesel is Groot.

programme.title: Hitman: Agent 47
programme.desc: The latest in a long line of genetically engineered clones bred to be the perfect assassin takes on a mission that strikes close to home. A corporation intends to use the technology that created him to build an army of superhuman killers. As the assassin fights to bring them down, he uncovers the dark secrets surrounding his origin. Action thriller, starring Rupert Friend, Hannah Ware and Zachary Quinto.

programme.title: Veronica Guerin
programme.desc: Fact-based drama about crime reporter Veronica Guerin, who set out to expose Ireland's crime lords but ended up paying the ultimate price. The film opens with the journalist's assassination, then looks back to trace her attempts to establish a link between Dublin's drug trade and infamous gangster Martin Cahill in the mid-1990s. Starring Cate Blanchett, Gerard McSorley, Ciaran Hinds and Brenda Fricker.

programme.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
programme.desc: An old man tells a journalist the story of his youth as a lobby boy at a hotel in Eastern Europe in the 1930s. He was taken under the wing of the establishment's dashing concierge, and is drawn into his misadventures as he becomes involved in a conflict over a valuable painting. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Ralph Fiennes, Tony Revolori, F Murray Abraham and Jude Law.

programme.title: Cars 2
programme.desc: Racing car Lightning McQueen heads overseas to compete in an international grand prix, with events in Britain, Japan and Italy. He gets mixed up in international espionage when a case of mistaken identity leads to an encounter with two English spy cars searching for a powerful gadget. programme.title: Mufasa: The Lion King
programme.desc: Mufasa, a cub lost and alone, meets a sympathetic lion named Taka, the heir to a royal bloodline - a chance meeting which sets in motion an expansive journey of a group of misfits searching for their destiny. Prequel to Disney's live-action 2019 movie, with the voices of Aaron Pierre, Kelvin Harrison Jnr and Tiffany Boone.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Laverstoke and GoodwoodJames is bringing his culinary tour of the UK to his neck of the woods as he spends precious time in his adopted home county of Hampshire. He's taking his gun dog Cooper to a training session at Laverstoke before cooking an amazing seasonal dish of partridge with vegetables and a sloe gin sauce. James hangs out with his best friend Jody Scheckter, an ex-Formula One racer with an epic car collection, and a surprising passion for buffalo mozzarella.

programme.title: Classic Mary Berry
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Classic ComfortsSoothing and much-loved home comfort delights, from the very simple to the extremely decadent. Mary indulges her love of comfort food with homely recipes to warm the heart including Eggs Benedict Florentine, fall-off-the-bone slow-cooked lamb shanks and deliciously rich chocolate truffle pots. She invites Swedish fire-chef Niklas Esktedt to share the joys of cave-man cooking with her, and enjoys his inventive venison meatballs with blackened celeriac and mouth-watering Swedish donuts.

programme.title: Classic Mary Berry
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Light, Easy and DeliciousMary returns to school to celebrate her light, easy and delicious cooking. From a simple version of the classic kedgeree and some delightful breakfast drop scones, to a moreish chicken, avocado and bacon salad and deliciously easy beef burgers. Mary takes her inspiration from a visit to a groundbreaking primary school in south London which has built a secret garden where they teach their students how to grow vegetables and look after a brood of chickens.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S14 E9 — Deli DeliberationRee is asking a trio of Osage's finest for feedback on some test recipes for her new deli. There are rival chicken fried steaks, two kinds of biscuits and two double-chocolate pies in the battle of the desserts.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S14 E10 — FAQ FreezerRee shares her best tips and tricks on everything freezer-friendly, including recipes like one dough that can be used for two types of cookies, butternut squash soup, spicy chicken spaghetti and a roasted tomatillo sauce.

Finally, James and Mark set themselves a fishing challenge by attempting to catch the King of the Sea: the mighty turbot.

programme.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
programme.desc: S1 E6 — DorsetJames discovers the delights of Dorset, joined on his trip by his mate and Michelin-starred chef Paul Ainsworth. They hop aboard a millionaire's yacht, where James cooks a delicious sea bass dish. Paul discovers some fantastic local cheese, while James visits a breeder with Mangalitsa pigs in a beautiful coastline setting. The highlight of their day is a beachside barbecue, where they feast on some amazing pork and chicken cooked al fresco.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: S2 E3Rick visits John Firth, who rears freshwater crayfish in Galloway, and cooks crayfish with pasta. He then travels to the picturesque town of Ludlow in Shropshire, which is as rich in gastronomic delights as it is in history.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: S2 E4Rick visits Cartmel in the Lake District, famous for its ancient 13th century Priory and Jean Johns' sticky toffee pudding. From her village shop in this tiny pretty village, truckloads of puddings are transported daily to all parts of Britain.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: S2 E5Rick visits Cork in Southern Ireland. At the English Market, the gastronomic heart of the city, he talks to retailers and cooks corned beef and cabbage. Still in Eire, he travels up the east coast to Waterford, a town usually renowned for its glass.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: S2 E6Rick is on home turf when he visits the Tintagel area in Cornwall. Here, legend has it, the ruined castle atop the craggy, untamed cliffs is what remains of King Arthur's Camelot.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: S2 E7In the Clovelly area of North Devon, Rick goes fishing for herring with Steve Perham, whose family have been fishermen for over 200 years. All that fresh sea air gives them a hearty appetite as Rick fries the herring in wholemeal flour.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: S2 E8Rick and Chalky travel to Loch Torridon in Scotland to go fishing with John McGregor for langoustines. Here the prawns are protected by the Marine Stewardship Council, which has awarded its seal of approval to the fishermen.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: S2 E9Rick pays a memorable visit to the Channel Island of Jersey, where he goes reef fishing for sea bass, which he then grills. He also makes a consommé and enjoys a beach barbecue.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes: Another Helping
programme.desc: S2 E10Rick takes a moonlit excursion off Newlyn Bay in Cornwall to go pilchard fishing with Nick Howell. Back on the beach, Rick barbecues the sardines and makes a piri piri sauce to accompany them.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: S1 E7 — YolanDa BrownPrue rustles up a classic French stew and is joined in the kitchen by award-winning musician and upcoming restaurateur YolanDa Brown. YolanDa cooks smoked salmon pasta for Prue while they chat about music.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S29 E15 — Piling on the PorkGuy Fieri digs in and pigs out on all things pork. After sampling a unique take on tacos in San Antonio, he heads to New Orleans to try pork knuckles.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S32 E1 — A World of BarbecueGuy Fieri is exploring an entire world of barbecue. After sampling smokin' chicken salad in Delaware he heads to Kauai for a traditional Hawaiian pig roast. In San Diego, a real-deal joint with Argentinean flavour.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S32 E2 — Sausage, Shawarma and ScaloppiniA funky Italian joint in Wilmington, Del., serves arancini and veal scaloppini; a Middle Eastern street food spot in San Diego serves shawarma and falafel; a not-your-typical pizza place in Vancouver tops things off with lamb sausage and pig cheeks.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S32 E4 — British, Hawaiian and MexicanGuy grabs grub from all around the globe; in Wilmington, Del., there's a true British pub serving authentic English staples from fish and chips to Yorkshire Pudding; a poke counter is dishing out a Hawaiian classic with an updated twist in Kauai.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S11 E2 — Po' Boys, Pasta and PorkGuy finds a Po-Boy shop in New Orleans, a restaurant serving fresh pasta in Spokane, Washington, and a barbecue spot in Minnesota.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S11 E3 — Funky FindsGuy finds a fish shack in New Jersey, that flies in fish from the Amazon, a small wood-fired pizza spot in Long Island.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S10 E12 — Wings 'n ThingsGuy Fieri visits America's most interesting and unique restaurants. Guy visits a Mexican café in New Jersey for chicken wings, a pizza spot in Idaho, and a Jamaican place in Nashville.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S9 E9 — Farm to TableIn Kentucky Guy visits a sandwich joint with homemade bread, tries Cajun coastal flavours in Georgia, and pizza in Washington, DC.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S55 E4 — Sandwiches, Sausage & Sweet SnacksSavouring sammies, sausage, and sweets; a funky Filipino joint in Sacramento, Calif., is making cookies; a West Palm Beach, Fla., spot is smoking gator sausage; an elevated eatery in Tampa, Fla., is plating an out-of-bounds Italian sandwich.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S55 E3 — From Bunny Chow to Chicken OystersGuy Fieri's digging into the unexpected! A South African spot in Black Mountain, NC, is cooking lights-out lamb curry, a chef in San Jose, CA, is bringing big flavour to beef barbacoa, and a Boynton Beach, FL, joint is serving up chicken oysters.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S9 E13 — Old Time AttitudeGuy Fieri visits America's most interesting and unique restaurants. Guy visits a classic restaurant in Nashville, a smoked barbecue joint in Georgia, and a seafood chowder and lobster spot in Maine.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S10 E4 — You Found EmGuy Fieri visits America's most interesting and unique restaurants. In Kentucky Guy visits a 1951 burger drive-in, a diner in Florida for meatloaf and a 60-year-old breakfast spot in Minnesota.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E3 — South Korea v Czechia 12.06South Korea v Czechia (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group A match at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Koreans are appearing at their 11th tournament in succession, and a 12th overall, and qualified after going unbeaten in 16 total matches across two rounds of qualifying in the Asian Confederation. Their best-ever performance at a World Cup saw them finish fourth in 2002 when they served as co-hosts alongside Japan, but since then they have failed to progress beyond the last-16, which was as far as they went four years ago in Qatar after suffering a 4-1 loss to Brazil in Doha. For Czechia, this is their first appearance at a World Cup since 2006 in Germany, and they were made to work hard for their place as they finished second in their qualifying group behind Croatia, which led to a place in the play-offs where they triumphed twice in penalty shootouts against Republic of Ireland and Denmark after both games ended in 2-2 draws. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: S2 E6 — North DonegalDermot O'Leary travels to Letterkenny in Co Donegal, discovering a place full of unforgettable people, stories and food. He forages for golden mushrooms in an ancient rainforest before learning to make tortellini completely from scratch. Dermot also meets a Syrian refugee-turned-honey farmer who teaches him how to extract honey from the hive and shares traditions from home, including how to enjoy honey with strong coffee and a sweet dish called knaffe.

programme.title: Dr No

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland

programme.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands

After discovering some award-winning gin, James meets a local forager and samples some of his elderflower wine. Finally, he uses some of the foraged elderflowers to make a delicious dessert.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E4 — Qatar v SwitzerlandQatar v Switzerland (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group B match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Qatar have earned outright qualification for a World Cup for the first time in their history, having made their only previous appearance at the tournament when they served as hosts four years ago. They'll hope to improve on that showing, when they lost all three of their group games against Netherlands, Senegal and Ecuador, scoring just one goal against the Senegalese in the process. The Swiss reached their sixth consecutive finals and 13th overall by topping a qualification group that contained Kosovo, Slovenia and Sweden, winning four and drawing two of their matches, while scoring 14 goals and conceding just two. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, and Qatar will hope to replicate the outcome of that friendly in 2018, in which they claimed a 1-0 victory. With analysis from Gary Neville, Ian Wright and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Action drama starring Liam Neeson and Forest Whitaker. Former government agent Bryan Mills is framed for murder and is forced to go on the run to clear his name.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E1 — SydneyThe actor and his son head for Australia, and begin their latest challenge in Sydney. There they take in the sights of the famous Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House with a terrifying aerobatic flight. The next day the duo head out of the city towards the beautiful Blue Mountains, but once again, Brad's fear of heights is put to the test when they take a ride on what turns out to be an extreme cable car.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E2 — Into the CountryBefore they leave the Blue Mountains, Barney has an extreme challenge planned for his dad as they must traverse a ravine on a rope. The men then head to the countryside and make a stop in the land of sheep, where they learn the art of shearing. Later, the road trip takes them to a tiny town where they join the local community who have organised a challenge that involves pulling a gigantic truck.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Australia v TürkiyeAustralia v Türkiye (Kick-off 5.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The Socceroos are appearing at their sixth consecutive finals, and a seventh overall, and will hope to build on their experience in Qatar four years ago when they progressed to the knockout stage for just the second time. They faced European opposition twice in the group stage on that occasion and had mixed fortunes, beginning their campaign with a 4-1 loss to eventual runners-up France, before beating Denmark 1-0 in their final group match, which helped them to move on to a meeting with eventual winners Argentina. In contrast, Türkiye have only appeared in World Cup finals on two previous occasions, most recently in 2002 when the competition had co-hosts for the first time in Japan and South Korea, and they will hope to perform just as admirably as they did on that occasion when they reached the semi-finals and were beaten 1-0 by eventual champions Brazil. With analysis from Ange Postecoglou and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E3 — LanguedocThe chef visits the Languedoc region, famous for its wine and the hearty, meaty dish cassoulet, and stops at a roadside fruit stall owned by a couple of British expats, before creating an unusual dish using melon and onion rings. He meets a modest chef who prepares a mouth-watering cassoulet, before staying at an 18th-century coach house and visiting a museum dedicated to Citroen 2CVs.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — CharenteThe chef travels through Charente in south-west France, visiting a distillery in the Cognac region, meeting a miller who still uses traditional methods to make award-winning brioche loaves, and following in the Queen Mother's footsteps with a visit to Chateau de Venteuil, home of the De La Rochefoucauld family. Along the way he makes classic French onion soup and a salad incorporating some of the region's best produce, and pays homage to the patron saint of pastry chefs with a stunning dessert.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S3 E8 — Summer FlavoursAinsley Harriott demonstrates recipes with sunny vibes that are perfect for those long, lazy days and holiday get-togethers, from Greek chicken gyros to mozzarella panzanella with a fruity twist. The Koreans are appearing at their 11th tournament in succession, and a 12th overall, and qualified after going unbeaten in 16 total matches across two rounds of qualifying in the Asian Confederation. Their best-ever performance at a World Cup saw them finish fourth in 2002 when they served as co-hosts alongside Japan, but since then they have failed to progress beyond the last-16, which was as far as they went four years ago in Qatar after suffering a 4-1 loss to Brazil in Doha. For Czechia, this is their first appearance at a World Cup since 2006 in Germany, and they were made to work hard for their place as they finished second in their qualifying group behind Croatia, which led to a place in the play-offs where they triumphed twice in penalty shootouts against Republic of Ireland and Denmark after both games ended in 2-2 draws. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E4 — Qatar v SwitzerlandQatar v Switzerland (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group B match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Qatar have earned outright qualification for a World Cup for the first time in their history, having made their only previous appearance at the tournament when they served as hosts four years ago. They'll hope to improve on that showing, when they lost all three of their group games against Netherlands, Senegal and Ecuador, scoring just one goal against the Senegalese in the process. The Swiss reached their sixth consecutive finals and 13th overall by topping a qualification group that contained Kosovo, Slovenia and Sweden, winning four and drawing two of their matches, while scoring 14 goals and conceding just two. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, and Qatar will hope to replicate the outcome of that friendly in 2018, in which they claimed a 1-0 victory. With analysis from Gary Neville, Ian Wright and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: E47 — 13/06/2026 - 3Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Action drama starring Liam Neeson and Forest Whitaker. Former government agent Bryan Mills is framed for murder and is forced to go on the run to clear his name.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E1 — SydneyThe actor and his son head for Australia, and begin their latest challenge in Sydney. There they take in the sights of the famous Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House with a terrifying aerobatic flight. The next day the duo head out of the city towards the beautiful Blue Mountains, but once again, Brad's fear of heights is put to the test when they take a ride on what turns out to be an extreme cable car.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E2 — Into the CountryBefore they leave the Blue Mountains, Barney has an extreme challenge planned for his dad as they must traverse a ravine on a rope. The men then head to the countryside and make a stop in the land of sheep, where they learn the art of shearing. Later, the road trip takes them to a tiny town where they join the local community who have organised a challenge that involves pulling a gigantic truck.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Australia v TürkiyeAustralia v Türkiye (Kick-off 5.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The Socceroos are appearing at their sixth consecutive finals, and a seventh overall, and will hope to build on their experience in Qatar four years ago when they progressed to the knockout stage for just the second time. They faced European opposition twice in the group stage on that occasion and had mixed fortunes, beginning their campaign with a 4-1 loss to eventual runners-up France, before beating Denmark 1-0 in their final group match, which helped them to move on to a meeting with eventual winners Argentina. In contrast, Türkiye have only appeared in World Cup finals on two previous occasions, most recently in 2002 when the competition had co-hosts for the first time in Japan and South Korea, and they will hope to perform just as admirably as they did on that occasion when they reached the semi-finals and were beaten 1-0 by eventual champions Brazil. With analysis from Ange Postecoglou and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E3 — LanguedocThe chef visits the Languedoc region, famous for its wine and the hearty, meaty dish cassoulet, and stops at a roadside fruit stall owned by a couple of British expats, before creating an unusual dish using melon and onion rings. He meets a modest chef who prepares a mouth-watering cassoulet, before staying at an 18th-century coach house and visiting a museum dedicated to Citroen 2CVs.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — CharenteThe chef travels through Charente in south-west France, visiting a distillery in the Cognac region, meeting a miller who still uses traditional methods to make award-winning brioche loaves, and following in the Queen Mother's footsteps with a visit to Chateau de Venteuil, home of the De La Rochefoucauld family. Along the way he makes classic French onion soup and a salad incorporating some of the region's best produce, and pays homage to the patron saint of pastry chefs with a stunning dessert.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S3 E8 — Summer FlavoursAinsley Harriott demonstrates recipes with sunny vibes that are perfect for those long, lazy days and holiday get-togethers, from Greek chicken gyros to mozzarella panzanella with a fruity twist. Lisa Snowdon pops in to make her summertime favourite seafood linguine, and chef Joseph Denison Carey goes strawberry picking in the sun.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Gary LinekerFootballer-turned-presenter Gary Lineker gets the grilling of a lifetime as he faces questions from autistic and learning-disabled interviewers, asking if he was forced out by the BBC and who the worst person he has worked with is. From the Hand of God to his first love, no question is off the table and no subject out of bounds when it comes to the Assembly's line of enquiry - expect revelations, chaos, and a lot of laughs.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E4Adil Ray hosts the game of words as Emmerdale actors Lisa Riley and Mark Charnock take on the Rev Richard Coles and comedian Tim Vine. They all try to win big for their chosen charities.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E3 — South Korea v Czechia 12.06South Korea v Czechia (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group A match at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Koreans are appearing at their 11th tournament in succession, and a 12th overall, and qualified after going unbeaten in 16 total matches across two rounds of qualifying in the Asian Confederation. Their best-ever performance at a World Cup saw them finish fourth in 2002 when they served as co-hosts alongside Japan, but since then they have failed to progress beyond the last-16, which was as far as they went four years ago in Qatar after suffering a 4-1 loss to Brazil in Doha. For Czechia, this is their first appearance at a World Cup since 2006 in Germany, and they were made to work hard for their place as they finished second in their qualifying group behind Croatia, which led to a place in the play-offs where they triumphed twice in penalty shootouts against Republic of Ireland and Denmark after both games ended in 2-2 draws. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E3 — South Korea v Czechia 12.06South Korea v Czechia (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group A match at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Koreans are appearing at their 11th tournament in succession, and a 12th overall, and qualified after going unbeaten in 16 total matches across two rounds of qualifying in the Asian Confederation. Their best-ever performance at a World Cup saw them finish fourth in 2002 when they served as co-hosts alongside Japan, but since then they have failed to progress beyond the last-16, which was as far as they went four years ago in Qatar after suffering a 4-1 loss to Brazil in Doha. For Czechia, this is their first appearance at a World Cup since 2006 in Germany, and they were made to work hard for their place as they finished second in their qualifying group behind Croatia, which led to a place in the play-offs where they triumphed twice in penalty shootouts against Republic of Ireland and Denmark after both games ended in 2-2 draws. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E4 — Qatar v SwitzerlandQatar v Switzerland (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group B match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Qatar have earned outright qualification for a World Cup for the first time in their history, having made their only previous appearance at the tournament when they served as hosts four years ago. They'll hope to improve on that showing, when they lost all three of their group games against Netherlands, Senegal and Ecuador, scoring just one goal against the Senegalese in the process. The Swiss reached their sixth consecutive finals and 13th overall by topping a qualification group that contained Kosovo, Slovenia and Sweden, winning four and drawing two of their matches, while scoring 14 goals and conceding just two. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, and Qatar will hope to replicate the outcome of that friendly in 2018, in which they claimed a 1-0 victory. With analysis from Gary Neville, Ian Wright and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.desc: S7 E1 — SydneyThe actor and his son head for Australia, and begin their latest challenge in Sydney. There they take in the sights of the famous Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House with a terrifying aerobatic flight. The next day the duo head out of the city towards the beautiful Blue Mountains, but once again, Brad's fear of heights is put to the test when they take a ride on what turns out to be an extreme cable car.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E2 — Into the CountryBefore they leave the Blue Mountains, Barney has an extreme challenge planned for his dad as they must traverse a ravine on a rope. The men then head to the countryside and make a stop in the land of sheep, where they learn the art of shearing. Later, the road trip takes them to a tiny town where they join the local community who have organised a challenge that involves pulling a gigantic truck.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Australia v TürkiyeAustralia v Türkiye (Kick-off 5.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The Socceroos are appearing at their sixth consecutive finals, and a seventh overall, and will hope to build on their experience in Qatar four years ago when they progressed to the knockout stage for just the second time. They faced European opposition twice in the group stage on that occasion and had mixed fortunes, beginning their campaign with a 4-1 loss to eventual runners-up France, before beating Denmark 1-0 in their final group match, which helped them to move on to a meeting with eventual winners Argentina. In contrast, Türkiye have only appeared in World Cup finals on two previous occasions, most recently in 2002 when the competition had co-hosts for the first time in Japan and South Korea, and they will hope to perform just as admirably as they did on that occasion when they reached the semi-finals and were beaten 1-0 by eventual champions Brazil. With analysis from Ange Postecoglou and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E3 — LanguedocThe chef visits the Languedoc region, famous for its wine and the hearty, meaty dish cassoulet, and stops at a roadside fruit stall owned by a couple of British expats, before creating an unusual dish using melon and onion rings. He meets a modest chef who prepares a mouth-watering cassoulet, before staying at an 18th-century coach house and visiting a museum dedicated to Citroen 2CVs.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — CharenteThe chef travels through Charente in south-west France, visiting a distillery in the Cognac region, meeting a miller who still uses traditional methods to make award-winning brioche loaves, and following in the Queen Mother's footsteps with a visit to Chateau de Venteuil, home of the De La Rochefoucauld family. Along the way he makes classic French onion soup and a salad incorporating some of the region's best produce, and pays homage to the patron saint of pastry chefs with a stunning dessert.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S3 E8 — Summer FlavoursAinsley Harriott demonstrates recipes with sunny vibes that are perfect for those long, lazy days and holiday get-togethers, from Greek chicken gyros to mozzarella panzanella with a fruity twist. Lisa Snowdon pops in to make her summertime favourite seafood linguine, and chef Joseph Denison Carey goes strawberry picking in the sun.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Gary LinekerFootballer-turned-presenter Gary Lineker gets the grilling of a lifetime as he faces questions from autistic and learning-disabled interviewers, asking if he was forced out by the BBC and who the worst person he has worked with is. From the Hand of God to his first love, no question is off the table and no subject out of bounds when it comes to the Assembly's line of enquiry - expect revelations, chaos, and a lot of laughs.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E4Adil Ray hosts the game of words as Emmerdale actors Lisa Riley and Mark Charnock take on the Rev Richard Coles and comedian Tim Vine. They all try to win big for their chosen charities.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E3 — South Korea v Czechia 12.06South Korea v Czechia (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group A match at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Koreans are appearing at their 11th tournament in succession, and a 12th overall, and qualified after going unbeaten in 16 total matches across two rounds of qualifying in the Asian Confederation. Their best-ever performance at a World Cup saw them finish fourth in 2002 when they served as co-hosts alongside Japan, but since then they have failed to progress beyond the last-16, which was as far as they went four years ago in Qatar after suffering a 4-1 loss to Brazil in Doha. For Czechia, this is their first appearance at a World Cup since 2006 in Germany, and they were made to work hard for their place as they finished second in their qualifying group behind Croatia, which led to a place in the play-offs where they triumphed twice in penalty shootouts against Republic of Ireland and Denmark after both games ended in 2-2 draws. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.desc: Australia v TürkiyeAustralia v Türkiye (Kick-off 5.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The Socceroos are appearing at their sixth consecutive finals, and a seventh overall, and will hope to build on their experience in Qatar four years ago when they progressed to the knockout stage for just the second time. They faced European opposition twice in the group stage on that occasion and had mixed fortunes, beginning their campaign with a 4-1 loss to eventual runners-up France, before beating Denmark 1-0 in their final group match, which helped them to move on to a meeting with eventual winners Argentina. In contrast, Türkiye have only appeared in World Cup finals on two previous occasions, most recently in 2002 when the competition had co-hosts for the first time in Japan and South Korea, and they will hope to perform just as admirably as they did on that occasion when they reached the semi-finals and were beaten 1-0 by eventual champions Brazil. With analysis from Ange Postecoglou and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

He meets a modest chef who prepares a mouth-watering cassoulet, before staying at an 18th-century coach house and visiting a museum dedicated to Citroen 2CVs.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — CharenteThe chef travels through Charente in south-west France, visiting a distillery in the Cognac region, meeting a miller who still uses traditional methods to make award-winning brioche loaves, and following in the Queen Mother's footsteps with a visit to Chateau de Venteuil, home of the De La Rochefoucauld family. Lisa Snowdon pops in to make her summertime favourite seafood linguine, and chef Joseph Denison Carey goes strawberry picking in the sun.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Gary LinekerFootballer-turned-presenter Gary Lineker gets the grilling of a lifetime as he faces questions from autistic and learning-disabled interviewers, asking if he was forced out by the BBC and who the worst person he has worked with is. From the Hand of God to his first love, no question is off the table and no subject out of bounds when it comes to the Assembly's line of enquiry - expect revelations, chaos, and a lot of laughs.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E4Adil Ray hosts the game of words as Emmerdale actors Lisa Riley and Mark Charnock take on the Rev Richard Coles and comedian Tim Vine. They all try to win big for their chosen charities.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E3 — South Korea v Czechia 12.06South Korea v Czechia (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group A match at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Koreans are appearing at their 11th tournament in succession, and a 12th overall, and qualified after going unbeaten in 16 total matches across two rounds of qualifying in the Asian Confederation. Their best-ever performance at a World Cup saw them finish fourth in 2002 when they served as co-hosts alongside Japan, but since then they have failed to progress beyond the last-16, which was as far as they went four years ago in Qatar after suffering a 4-1 loss to Brazil in Doha. For Czechia, this is their first appearance at a World Cup since 2006 in Germany, and they were made to work hard for their place as they finished second in their qualifying group behind Croatia, which led to a place in the play-offs where they triumphed twice in penalty shootouts against Republic of Ireland and Denmark after both games ended in 2-2 draws. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E4 — Qatar v SwitzerlandQatar v Switzerland (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group B match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Qatar have earned outright qualification for a World Cup for the first time in their history, having made their only previous appearance at the tournament when they served as hosts four years ago. They'll hope to improve on that showing, when they lost all three of their group games against Netherlands, Senegal and Ecuador, scoring just one goal against the Senegalese in the process. The Swiss reached their sixth consecutive finals and 13th overall by topping a qualification group that contained Kosovo, Slovenia and Sweden, winning four and drawing two of their matches, while scoring 14 goals and conceding just two. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, and Qatar will hope to replicate the outcome of that friendly in 2018, in which they claimed a 1-0 victory. With analysis from Gary Neville, Ian Wright and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E1 — SydneyThe actor and his son head for Australia, and begin their latest challenge in Sydney. There they take in the sights of the famous Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House with a terrifying aerobatic flight. The next day the duo head out of the city towards the beautiful Blue Mountains, but once again, Brad's fear of heights is put to the test when they take a ride on what turns out to be an extreme cable car.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E2 — Into the CountryBefore they leave the Blue Mountains, Barney has an extreme challenge planned for his dad as they must traverse a ravine on a rope. The men then head to the countryside and make a stop in the land of sheep, where they learn the art of shearing. Later, the road trip takes them to a tiny town where they join the local community who have organised a challenge that involves pulling a gigantic truck.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Australia v TürkiyeAustralia v Türkiye (Kick-off 5.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The Socceroos are appearing at their sixth consecutive finals, and a seventh overall, and will hope to build on their experience in Qatar four years ago when they progressed to the knockout stage for just the second time. They faced European opposition twice in the group stage on that occasion and had mixed fortunes, beginning their campaign with a 4-1 loss to eventual runners-up France, before beating Denmark 1-0 in their final group match, which helped them to move on to a meeting with eventual winners Argentina. In contrast, Türkiye have only appeared in World Cup finals on two previous occasions, most recently in 2002 when the competition had co-hosts for the first time in Japan and South Korea, and they will hope to perform just as admirably as they did on that occasion when they reached the semi-finals and were beaten 1-0 by eventual champions Brazil. With analysis from Ange Postecoglou and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.

programme.desc: S1 E3 — LanguedocThe chef visits the Languedoc region, famous for its wine and the hearty, meaty dish cassoulet, and stops at a roadside fruit stall owned by a couple of British expats, before creating an unusual dish using melon and onion rings. He meets a modest chef who prepares a mouth-watering cassoulet, before staying at an 18th-century coach house and visiting a museum dedicated to Citroen 2CVs.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E4 — CharenteThe chef travels through Charente in south-west France, visiting a distillery in the Cognac region, meeting a miller who still uses traditional methods to make award-winning brioche loaves, and following in the Queen Mother's footsteps with a visit to Chateau de Venteuil, home of the De La Rochefoucauld family. Along the way he makes classic French onion soup and a salad incorporating some of the region's best produce, and pays homage to the patron saint of pastry chefs with a stunning dessert.

For Czechia, this is their first appearance at a World Cup since 2006 in Germany, and they were made to work hard for their place as they finished second in their qualifying group behind Croatia, which led to a place in the play-offs where they triumphed twice in penalty shootouts against Republic of Ireland and Denmark after both games ended in 2-2 draws. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E4 — Qatar v SwitzerlandQatar v Switzerland (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group B match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Qatar have earned outright qualification for a World Cup for the first time in their history, having made their only previous appearance at the tournament when they served as hosts four years ago. They'll hope to improve on that showing, when they lost all three of their group games against Netherlands, Senegal and Ecuador, scoring just one goal against the Senegalese in the process. The Swiss reached their sixth consecutive finals and 13th overall by topping a qualification group that contained Kosovo, Slovenia and Sweden, winning four and drawing two of their matches, while scoring 14 goals and conceding just two. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, and Qatar will hope to replicate the outcome of that friendly in 2018, in which they claimed a 1-0 victory. With analysis from Gary Neville, Ian Wright and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Australia v TürkiyeAustralia v Türkiye (Kick-off 5.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The Socceroos are appearing at their sixth consecutive finals, and a seventh overall, and will hope to build on their experience in Qatar four years ago when they progressed to the knockout stage for just the second time. They faced European opposition twice in the group stage on that occasion and had mixed fortunes, beginning their campaign with a 4-1 loss to eventual runners-up France, before beating Denmark 1-0 in their final group match, which helped them to move on to a meeting with eventual winners Argentina. In contrast, Türkiye have only appeared in World Cup finals on two previous occasions, most recently in 2002 when the competition had co-hosts for the first time in Japan and South Korea, and they will hope to perform just as admirably as they did on that occasion when they reached the semi-finals and were beaten 1-0 by eventual champions Brazil. With analysis from Ange Postecoglou and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward.
